name: Chouhatsu Maid no Ecchi na Gohoushi
original_name: 挑発メイドのエッチなご奉仕
source:
"Goshujinsama, why do you get hard before I even touch you?"

An adaptation of the erotic voice drama into a novel-style game.
Three of the 4 chapters of original voice drama are incorporated. Some rewriting was done. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE172278.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“主人，明明我还没碰你，你为什么就硬了？”

一款将色情语音剧改编为小说式游戏的作品。原语音剧4章中的3章被收录其中，并进行了一些重写。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE172278.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
